text:
sasha: Heads-up — I pushed a draft 'What's New' blurb for the coming docs release. Need a quick QA pass for accuracy, SDK snippets, and any known issues to call out. PTAL :eyes:
rachel: On it. Link the draft?
sasha: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/whatsnew/draft-3469 — note the embedding section changed API name to `embeddings.create_v2` so samples need updating.
tim: I can update the Python snippet. Do we prefer short inline examples or full function examples?
sasha: Short inline for the whatsnew page, full example in the SDK migration guide. Keep the inline <=3 lines.
leo: Also flagging a known issue: running quantized models on older GPUs can return slightly different logits for long sequences — recommend callout under "Known issues".
rachel: Got the embed API rename. Quick patch suggestion for Python: `resp = client.embeddings.create_v2(model="rwd-embed-1", input=["hello"])` — I'll add that to the draft.
sasha: Perfect. Also we should add a short migration note for JS users — minimal example and a link to the full guide.
tim: JS snippet suggestion: ```const resp = await client.embeddings.createV2({model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: ['hello']});``` small enough.
leo: For links: please run the link-checker script before merge. I got a 404 on the rollout-policy anchor earlier.
devex-bot: CI status for PR #8394: linkcheck passed, lint failed (one trailing whitespace). https://ci.internal/builds/8394
sasha: Thanks bot. @rachel can you fix the whitespace and also add the Known issues blurb about quantization? Small paragraph + bug tracker link.
rachel: Will do this afternoon. I'll also add a short note about fallback routing staying stable for pinned model versions.
tim: One ask — can we include a short note for Dedicated customers about the latency SLO tweak? 1 line under Platform changes.
sasha: Yes, add one sentence and link to the dedicated changelog entry. Keep it hidden behind the enterprise note with a short CTA to contact sales.
leo: After edits, I'll run the staging linkcheck & QA sweep. If all green, we can merge and schedule publish Tuesday morning. :thumbsup:
rachel: Done — pushed commit that updates snippets and Known issues.
sasha: Awesome. If staging passes we'll ship Tuesday. Thanks everyone.
